basic_profile.bio: I'm a passionate bookworm hailing from Portland, Oregon. I work as a librarian, which perfectly aligns with my love for literature. Outside of work, I often find myself diving into video games, particularly role-playing games like Ghost Recon Breakpoint. I have a keen interest in maintaining a healthy lifestyle, recently getting into gut health research. Although I'm single, I cherish the online communities I've become a part of over the years. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in English Literature and have spent over a decade working in libraries. My knowledge extends to a wide range of literary genres, from classics to contemporary fiction. I am also an avid gamer, often exploring game narrative structures.
